description: Find WordPress (or WooCommerce) plugins that are commercial opportunities — large, established user bases paired with abandonment, low ratings, or poor support, i.e. plugins you could realistically replace or out-build. Use a `preset` for a curated angle, and/or narrow by `tag` (niche), install range, and max rating. Returns a ranked, capped list with opportunity scores. Powered by wpgoldmine.io.

ecosystem.description: Which catalog to search. Defaults to wordpress.

limit.description: Max results. Requires WPGOLDMINE_API_KEY; the free tier is capped at 10.

max_rating.description: Maximum rating on a 0-100 scale (lower = more dissatisfied users).

preset.description: A preset key from list_opportunity_presets (e.g. "abandoned-plugins"). Composes with `tag`.

tag.description: Narrow to a niche by WordPress.org tag/slug, e.g. "seo", "forms", "backup".

name: find_plugin_opportunities
title: Find WordPress plugin opportunities
